mapper.select: SELECT LOWER(TABLE_NAME) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
SELECT CONCAT(LOWER(TABLE_NAME), '.', LOWER(COLUMN_NAME)) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
